title: The Signature Approach to Neuromorphic Computing Chips (Signature)
provenance: Signature original design work by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH). Signature-labeled original designs and improvements — original work, not presented as established public fact.
description: The Signature approach builds the full stack at once: a spiking SoC with on-chip surrogate-gradient learning, a compiler that converts GPU models with <1% accuracy loss, and a $99 developer board. Neuromorphic stops being a lab curiosity and becomes a platform. This is Signature original work by Justin Addam Higgins: an original design direction for Neuromorphic Computing Chips, labeled as Signature throughout, and never presented as established public fact. Signature neuromorphic ships as a platform: the chip learns on-device, the compiler speaks PyTorch, and robots run whole spiking control loops. Milliwatt intelligence goes everywhere batteries go.

Signature vision: Signature neuromorphic ships as a platform: the chip learns on-device, the compiler speaks PyTorch, and robots run whole spiking control loops.
